Going forward, [b]Ariadne[/b] will do her best to set you up.
All her efforts go into a devastating [b]arena-wide spell[/b] that reduces the [b]HP[/b] of all targets to [b]1[/b]

tags.balance_change: all [b]stats[/b] have been carefully [b]readjusted[/b] for each individual [b]phase[/b]
Attacks feel a lot more deadly and the phases themselves flow a bit [b]quicker[/b]
Enemies generally live longer, but [b]Equipment[/b] makes a much bigger difference now.

tags.feature: To kickstart [b]Lorna's[/b] adventures, she'll now receive a [b]weapon[/b] through a little [b]event[/b] just a couple of steps away from the initial spawning point.
And since Lorna's story is all about taking matters into her [b]own hands[/b], she now gets to wield a very special [b]axe[/b]

tags.balance_change: In addition to an overall [b]stats[/b] and [b]loot table[/b] reworks

tags.feature: a tribe of Goblins intend to cause big trouble in little ParAdise.

tags.balance_change: they're already a lot stronger than the other enemies you've faced.

tags.feature: The [b]tiles[/b] of Paradise's first map have been massively reworked.
[b]Hilltops[/b] now have their own distinctive color and the [b]ground[/b] is in general is [b]much less busy[/b] on the eyes.
[b]Trees[/b] have been repositioned to allow for smoother [b]movement[/b] across the map.
Next to a lot more [b]props[/b] all over the place, the outside parts of a [b]toll-house[/b] now overlook the river separating north from south.
If you've been looking for a way to spend your [b]Polygons[/b], Ari's got your back!
From [b]consumables[/b] to starter [b]equipment[/b], she loves nothing more than sorting you out.
There's rumors she even temporarily got her hands on some [b]special stuff[/b]
Oftentimes in [b]history[/b], we see the past only through little [b]fragments[/b] here and there.
It's for us to connect these bits and pieces in an effort to make sense of it.
Although the [b]old word[/b] is lost, it's [b]not forgotten[/b].
Like a present, it's waiting to unwrap itself in front you.
Interacting with [b]Fragments[/b] triggers an old world [b]memory[/b].
Players get to witness a moment in TRACHI's history, currently represented by a collection of [b]InvAsion scenes[/b].
They offer a snapshot of a moment in the [b]character's previous lives[/b].
The characters get to remember, and you get to find something out about them.
And maybe, you get to keep a little [b]souvenir[/b]
Sometimes things don't go as planned.
Sometimes you'd rather be [b]somewhere else[/b].
Going forward, you can return to the [b]Start Menu[/b] (almost) whenever you please.
As a bonus, the [b]chapter selection[/b] has also received a slight [b]visual[/b] rework.
They say: "Clothes make the man".
Does that go for [b]fictional people[/b], too?
In ANARCHY, characters are represented as [b]base classes[/b] with a whole set of different [b]VariAtions[/b].
At the moment, the system itself is mostly used within [b]Fragment Scenes[/b].
Though I'd love for you to have additional options for [b]customization[/b], too!
As a thank you to the absolute awesome bunch of people that invested their valuable time to overcome [b]ExcommunicAtion[/b] during [b]0.1.1[/b], a new [b]skin[/b] is now available for [b]Daphne[/b].
Going forward, I'd like to at least include one VariAtion per patch.
These will be tied to a monthly challenge represented by a special [b]achievements[/b]
If you like what you see and haven't completed [b]ExcommunicAtion[/b] yet – don't worry!
There'll be plenty more opportunities to grab this [b]cosmetic[/b] down the line.

Beyond potential [b]reruns[/b], there are also plans to couple VariAtions with [b]Steam's Inventory System[/b] and thus open the door for [b]trading[/b], [b]buying/selling[/b] on the [b]market[/b] and/or purchase the item as a [b]DLC[/b]
As you can see, there's tons of elements going into [b]ANARCHY[/b]
It's my [b]responsibility[/b] to not only work on these segments, but also tie them together in a [b]meaningful way[/b]
Your presence helps me to discern [b]essential features[/b] from [b]flavor stuff[/b] – and serves as a continuous [b]encouragement[/b] for me to keep going.
As such, I'd like to – once again – [b]thank you so much for all the support[/b]!
I hope you'll enjoy this update as another big leap forward to transform the world of [b]TRACHI[/b] into a video game.
I'll be back soon to talk more about the next [b]milestone[/b] – henceforth known as [b]ANARCHY 0.1.3 (Marché)[/b]

notes.title: Vanguard
notes.content:
[h3]Hey non-fictional friends! 👋[/h3] 

As promised, here's more info on [b]ANARCHY 0.1.2 (Encore)[/b]. We're dangerously close to [b]release[/b] – a perfect chance for a little heads-up, a gentle reminder and a couple of deets!

[h3]Let's do exactly that![/h3]
The final [b]development[/b] stretch is going exceedingly well. As of Thursday, we're [b]feature complete[/b]. Highlights include the first set of [b]InvAsion[/b] scenes, a rework of [b]ExcommunicAtion's Phase 4[/b] – and a record-shattering amount of additions to [b]ParAdise[/b].

I'll squeeze in bit of extra [b]QA[/b] this weekend to make sure it's all nice and pretty for you. 
Which means it's time for me to commit myself. 😳

[h2][b]October 23rd 📅[/b][/h2]
Next Monday, [b]ANARCHY 0.1.2[/b] goes live. I'll cover the features in a separate [b]post[/b] published alongside the update. We'll also have an in-depth look at it during this Sunday's [b]devlog[/b].
[previewyoutube=Wopskz2cv-s;full][/previewyoutube] Needless to say, I'm stoked! This update is the first step towards bridging [b]AUTONOMY[/b] and [b]ANARCHY[/b]. It feels like coming home to a new place – and what better way to celebrate than to give back to a couple of friends? 

[h1]Standing Out[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/1976e9a920a5d4a8f5541d7a986ba1afea518357.png[/img]
Remember the [b]achievement[/b] for completing ExcommunicAtion? I [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2169000/view/3713837177195369430?l=english]mentioned[/url] early-bird [b]rewards[/b]. There was a lot of back and forth during development, but I'm incredibly proud to announce that there's already a functioning [b]prototype[/b] system in place.

[h1]VariAtion[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/d0a1384a11ead3b11434688427d2cd1c0360f6d3.png[/img]
Launching 0.1.2 for the very first [b]time[/b] runs a check on whether you've [b]completed ExcommunicAtion[/b]. If you did, you'll get a new [b]appearance[/b] for [b]Daphne[/b]. In addition to her [b]default[/b] look, you can have her hop into an [b]EnKAD uniform[/b] – with different sprites and a matching set of portraits.

[h1]Deadline[/h1]
Chances are, you're already part of the [b]eligible 50%[/b]. If not, there's still a good amount of time. Especially considering there's settings allowing you to jump straight into ExcommunicAtion's later phases – and/or [b]skip conversations[/b]. But you didn't hear that from me, okay? 😏

Either way, I'll end it here and resume the playtesting grind. [b]Thank you[/b] – as always – very much for your valuable time.

Have a great weekend, champs! 😊


much love
nory

notes.title: Encore (Preview)
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, friends! 😊[/h2]

We're about [b]halfway[/b] on the road towards [b]ANARCHY's second update[/b]. There's [b]a lot[/b] to unpack already, and I can't wait to present it all to you! So without further ado –

[h1]Point 1.2[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/bb82f5c27ebd0c14be5be9492096c40e60fec5ad.png[/img]
[b]0.1.1[/b] ([i]Trois[/i]) put a big focus on [b]infrastructure[/b]. Largely thanks to that, we can now shift gears steadily towards rolling out [b]new content[/b]. Highlights include a rework of [b]ExcommunicAtion's Phase 4[/b], big improvements to [b]ParAdise's starting area[/b] and – last but not least – the first couple of [b]InvAsion scenes[/b].

[h1]Home again.[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/b40ac0497b828ecdea6a0a23bd1be2c754bda7c7.png[/img]
Revisiting these brought back tons of [b]memories[/b]. [b]InvAsion[/b] was my first [b]Unity[/b] project, and it shows! There's big post-autonomy "sky is the limit" vibes – both in terms of [b]content[/b] and [b]infrastructure[/b].

Going in, I tried to get rough [b]idea[/b] of how much work [b](re)implementing[/b] these scenes would be. So I started by [b]reworking[/b] the scenes' [b]basic setup[/b]. In other words: It might get a bit technical now. 😳

[h1]Then.[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/b91f959c05353337a502f382ca17e22fe03b0335.png[/img]
[b]InvAsion[/b] was originally built around an RPG Kit called [b]ORK Framework[/b]. Halfway during development, I ported all the [b]conversations[/b] into a dedicated [b]Dialogue System[/b]. In the end, ORK was completely cut from the final build, since InvAsion was mostly comprised of conversations.

[h1]Now.[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/6426ffcabdd27216a240efaacc9e5a5f7cc8d09e.png[/img]
[b]ANARCHY[/b] on the other hand heavily uses the [b]RPG elements[/b]. So the overarching infrastructural goal here was to embed [b]InvAsion's (Dialogue System) conversations[/b] into [b]ORK[/b]. For the most part, you won't notice a difference – barring new [b]UI elements[/b] and a couple of other details.

[h1]Fast to Past[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/811135bdfc515e269001d3004c64b4f7de3a425c.png[/img]
The actual [b]dialogue[/b] has mostly been [b]left intact[/b]. Thirteen months later, the lines still hit the same. And the [b]acoustic BGM[/b] is a great change of pace compared to the [b]J-Rock[/b] tracks you're encountering for example during [b]ExcommunicAtion[/b]. 

All in all, these scenes are big [b]nostalgia[/b] trip, and they're a perfect fit for a game centered around [b](re)discovering yourself[/b].

[h1]The Point[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/f9cd49ca95d689734e63fb293c0e074fb1813b78.png[/img]
During the events of [b]ParAdise and on[/b], characters rediscover their [b]memories[/b] by reliving key moments of their [b]original lives[/b] – i.e InvAsion et al. Completing these [b]"Fragments"[/b] will not only offer additional [b]exposition[/b], but also directly affect the characters by unlocking [b]status bonuses[/b], [b]abilities[/b], [b]equipment[/b] and so on.

[h1]Memories[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/3a859441e4d6a19b1187f19c68ba70efa2fc1dcc.png[/img]
Essential memories will be directly tied to the [b]main story quest[/b]. Naturally, there's also plans for a lot of [b]optional sequences[/b] that you can discover either through completing [b]side-quests[/b], stumbling upon [b]Mementos[/b] or interacting with [b]other characters[/b]. 

This should make a great incentive to go out and [b]explore[/b], especially due to the fact that it – in most cases – improves the [b]characters[/b] capabilities, too.

[h1]Economy[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/85d6347bb25a019a1d19dfe6f6d3454303478c00.png[/img]
Speaking of [b]interactions[/b]: A [b]familiar face[/b] has set up a little [b]shop[/b] in ParAdise. Just like her mythological namesake, our very own [b]Ariadne[/b] is – once again – here to help you out. At the moment, she offers a small selection of [b]items[/b] and [b]equipment[/b], with a potential to unlock more goodies down the road.

[h1]ParAdise[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/90c95d51020e8ec836532eed52cd3c1fce6a0be7.png[/img]
Overall, [b]ParAdise's first map[/b] has received a lot of love. It's an ongoing process, and will likely take a couple of months until the map itself is somewhat presentable. But I'm getting more and more comfortable working with the [b]new tiles[/b]. 

During AUTONOMY, I made a lot of [b]maps[/b] simply because making them [b]felt good[/b], and I'm already starting to get that exact feeling again.

[h1]What's left[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/2d9d0c466ccb43e9df0e33ee7fa0089fa7f11dbe.png[/img]
I mentioned a rework of [b]ExcommunicAtion's Phase 4[/b]. It's planned to happen this weekend, so there's not much to show yet. But here's what I'm [b]planning[/b] to do: Both Icarus and Ariadne will get a [b]unique ability[/b] each. 

[b]Icarus[/b] will have an [b]aura[/b] that transfers a portion of damage dealt to [b]Ganymede[/b] onto himself. [b]Ariadne[/b] on the other hand will get a [b]big AoE[/b] that takes an entire turn just to build up. Any [b]damage[/b] inflicted to her in the meantime will [b]cancel[/b] the cast. In other words: It falls to [b]Daphne[/b] (and you) to give [b]Ariadne[/b] the time she needs.

[h1]Branching out[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/feb5b944e2b2107e9206295a85321fea14473bc0.png[/img]
If you'd like to preview any of these changes for yourself, you can now switch between the [b]live[/b] and [b]beta[/b] branch. In most cases, both your [b]settings[/b] and [b]progression[/b] should be [b]fully compatible[/b]. If not, please be so kind and get in touch with me. 😙

[h1]To conclude[/h1]
As you can see, [b]0.1.2[/b] packs quite a punch. I'm super satisfied with the current pace, especially since around [b]2/3 of the changes[/b] are already in. In accordance to what I said above, I'll try to get the [b]ExcommunicAtion[/b] bits set up during the next couple of days.

Afterwards, I'd like to reimplement another [b]InvAsion scene[/b]. I'd love to tell you all about it! Luckiliy for the two of us – there's no need! A very [b]talented and special [url=https://twitter.com/houndsjaw]friend[/url][/b] put it far better than I ever could:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/243ab8448399ee29dd01da7d25bf9ceadda57d18.png[/img]
I hope [b]you[/b] and [b]everyone you love[/b] have a great couple of days! ❤
Soon enough, we'll talk more about 0.1.2.

Until then – as always – [b]big, big hugs[/b] to you! 🤗

[b]much love[/b]
nory

notes.title: Un Deux Trois
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey friends & family! 😊[/b][/h2]

[b]ANARCHY's first update is finally here![/b]

[b]0.1.1 (Trois)[/b] comes with tons of [b]new features[/b], changes and improvements ALL across the board. From [b]Combat[/b] to [b]RPG Elements[/b], a lot more bits of [b]ParAdise[/b], [b]UI[/b], [b]camera[/b] and [b]backend improvements[/b] – this one has it all. And seeing as the two of us are already here –

[h2]Let's have a little chat![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/bac95b183cb44f70f835a6f78b98cd918baebe28.png[/img]

You've already seen it: [b]Achievement(s)[/b]! This one's awarded for completing [b]ExcommunicAtion[/b] and goes hand in hand with [b]unlocking ParAdise[/b]. If you've already done that during 0.1, you'll get it when you start 0.1.1 for the first time.

[h2]Status Screen[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/4f5ed1327fd0805a154b07da990a9e7959fb09f1.png[/img]
As announced in the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2169000/view/3686813676048584147?l=english]preview[/url][/b], the [b]Status Screen[/b] displays an extended overview of your [b]current character's stats[/b]. Noteworthy are [b]HP[/b] (Hitpoints), [b]ATK[/b] (Attack) and [b]DEF [/b](Defense). These directly drive [b]damage calculations[/b], and you can track their [b]growth[/b] throughout the [b]phases of ExcommunicAtion[/b] and your [b]playthrough of ParAdise[/b].

[h2]Target Info HUD[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/dd5e72f47426910e89a8a0988a2b7fe9b1e6bae9.png[/img]
In a similar fashion, you can also get more info on the currently selected target. The [b]Target HUD[/b] now comes with a little [b]Info Box[/b] you can fold out to show both [b]extended stats[/b] and [b]passive abilities[/b]. 

Currently, [b]passives[/b] are just [b]cosmetic[/b] and mostly there for [b]lore[/b] reasons. They're however already set up to individually [b]customise combatants[/b] through passive (unlockable) [b]traits[/b].

[h2]Glyphs[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/73bc875ce39e6fa3d59254e85dde1d4fe7e2ded7.png[/img]
These were already touched upon in the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2169000/view/3686813676048584147?l=english]preview[/url][/b], as well. You've also likely spotted them in the previous sections. These [b]dynamic glyphs[/b] display [b]input keys[/b] and have now been implemented all over the game. They update automatically to reflect your individual [b]key mappings[/b] set in the [b]Input screen[/b] and your current [b]input device[/b].

[h2]!Conversation[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/8a20d232c456a0242a2f3967f9e00ad70287d98d.png[/img]
A new option – [b]Conversations[/b] – allows you to [b]toggle ExcommunicAtion dialogue[/b] on and off respectively. Think of this as the equivalent of a "story-mode" difficulty – just reversed. You'll get all the [b]combat and gameplay segments[/b], without being interrupted by dialogue.

[h2]Mono Trouble[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/d52fdcc976559f80b8b3997b67c6ae6482aec8ad.png[/img]
ExcommunicAtion's [b]phase 3[/b] has undergone a rework focusing on [b]AI target selection[/b]. Previously, Ganymede had a [b]5% chance[/b] to hit an [b]enemy Monolith[/b] and turn it back to [b]his side[/b]. Going forward, he'll be much more persistent.

[h2]Un Deux Trois[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/5c83f54623f141b12fa16b3e1f4e4b5474ede140.png[/img]
Starting with [b]0.1.1[/b], Ganymede has his eyes on the field. He'll probe it for Monoliths you've turned and [b]collectively hits them[/b] with a shiny new ability. It's pretty unfair, all things considered. But also something that can be dealt with.

[h2]ProvocAtion[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/31cd7c1d0f776b61c8189828814cf9e5cbfd322f.png[/img]
To counter Ganymede's fixation on Monoliths, our very own [b]Daphne[/b] will receive a new ability to apply a provoking [b]status effect[/b] on herself. This not only increases her [b]Defense[/b], but also [b]forces Ganymede to attack her and only her[/b].

[h2]Green Country[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/330bcd868576a580ccb0a259f524127a86920cae.png[/img]
Speaking of combat encounters, battles in [b]ParAdise[/b] have been almost completely restored and [b]enemies[/b] now have their own [b]status developments[/b]. A prime example of this change comes with the addition of a new big bad enemy that haunts Lorna during the early parts of her adventure.

[h2]Progression[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/192a704676d5e3abf1b0a05adffb4bf60b5289df.png[/img]
Naturally, the [b]player's people[/b] won't be stuck at [b]level 1[/b], either. Contrary to ExcommunicAtion, levelling up is not done through beating up Ganymede (over and over again), but driven by [b]EXP[/b] instead. EXP itself is gathered by – you guessed it – [b]killing things[/b]. But there's also [b]completing quests[/b] and [b]challenges[/b], among many other ways to further progress your characters.

[h2]Equipment[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/987b24400f169d9e0d85c5ce2411aadb4294dbdf.png[/img]
The [b]equipment system[/b] is already present in ExcommunicAtion, but without a way to functionally interact with it. For ParAdise, [b]equipment[/b] will play a massive role. So it's only reasonable that you're provided with both the [b]individual pieces[/b] and the infrastructure to [b]see and modify[/b] who's wearing what to which effect.

[h2]Last but not least[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/a1117fb7c97eb580f5e5aa8a95bcff07f88fd031.png[/img]
The few [b]story segments[/b] in ParAdise have also been completely restored. This paves the way for future updates to continue the story of Lorna and her – soon to be introduced – friends. I'm super excited to get into this once the initial segments have been fleshed out a bit more.

[h2]Speaking of Story[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/308c3f7fc17823adbb31b4e5c422767f787049db.png[/img]
It's more of an [b]outlook[/b] than anything else. But since we're approaching the end of the post anyway, I'd like to at least give you an idea of [b]what's next[/b]. I've teased it a couple of times already. This time around, I want to be a lot more concrete.

[h2]That's right![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/414c44cedc2f90ff8b935170eabf5cc6015eb3df.png[/img]
[b]InvAsion is coming home![/b] I won't get to deep into it here, but [b]0.1.2[/b] will put a heavy focus on polishing [b]dialogue interactions[/b] and creating a sustainable [b]tile-mapping infrastructure[/b]. InvAsion is thus the perfect poster child to not only [b]prototype[/b] and [b]polish[/b] these features, but also the perfect opportunity to integrate it into [b]ANARCHY proper[/b].

[h2]To Conclude[/h2]
If you're reading this, [b]ANARCHY 0.1.1 is live[/b]. Even though it's a huge update, the game itself is still in the early stages of [b]Early Access[/b]. I can't express how thankful I am both for your [b]trust[/b] and [b]continued interest[/b], especially from those who've already invested hours into either ANARCHY and/or AUTONOMY. 

It's nothing compared to the kindness you're giving me. But I want to leave you with [b]a little something[/b]. [b]Boot ANARCHY[/b] and grab the [b]achievement[/b] for completing ExcommunicAtion, if you haven't already. Word on the street is, it's good to have it when [b]0.1.2[/b] comes out.

Beyond that, feel free to grab a licence of [b]InvAsion[/b], too – if you don't mind. There'll be more announcements down the road, but chances are [b]it won't be available the way it is right now[/b] forever.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015930/TRACHI__InvAsion

As always,[b] thank you tons for reading this[/b]. I hope you'll enjoy both 0.1.1 and all the future updates to come! If there's anything I can do for you, you're always welcome to get in touch.

Until then, big hugs and kissies from a friend! 😘


[b]much love[/b]
nory

tags.feature: As announced in the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2169000/view/3686813676048584147?l=english]preview[/url][/b], the [b]Status Screen[/b] displays an extended overview of your [b]current character's stats[/b].

In a similar fashion, you can also get more info on the currently selected target. The [b]Target HUD[/b] now comes with a little [b]Info Box[/b] you can fold out to show both [b]extended stats[/b] and [b]passive abilities[/b].
These [b]dynamic glyphs[/b] display [b]input keys[/b] and have now been implemented all over the game.
A new option – [b]Conversations[/b] – allows you to [b]toggle ExcommunicAtion dialogue[/b] on and off respectively.

tags.bug: ExcommunicAtion's [b]phase 3[/b] has undergone a rework focusing on [b]AI target selection[/b].

tags.balance_change: Previously, Ganymede had a [b]5% chance[/b] to hit an [b]enemy Monolith[/b] and turn it back to [b]his side[/b]. Going forward, he'll be much more persistent.
Starting with [b]0.1.1[/b], Ganymede has his eyes on the field. He'll probe it for Monoliths you've turned and [b]collectively hits them[/b] with a shiny new ability.
To counter Ganymede's fixation on Monoliths, our very own [b]Daphne[/b] will receive a new ability to apply a provoking [b]status effect[/b] on herself.
This not only increases her [b]Defense[/b], but also [b]forces Ganymede to attack her and only her[/b].

tags.feature: Speaking of combat encounters, battles in [b]ParAdise[/b] have been almost completely restored and [b]enemies[/b] now have their own [b]status developments[/b].
A prime example of this change comes with the addition of a new big bad enemy that haunts Lorna during the early parts of her adventure.
Contrary to ExcommunicAtion, levelling up is not done through beating up Ganymede (over and over again), but driven by [b]EXP[/b] instead.
EXP itself is gathered by – you guessed it – [b]killing things[/b]. But there's also [b]completing quests[/b] and [b]challenges[/b], among many other ways to further progress your characters.
The [b]equipment system[/b] is already present in ExcommunicAtion, but without a way to functionally interact with it.

For ParAdise, [b]equipment[/b] will play a massive role. So it's only reasonable that you're provided with both the [b]individual pieces[/b] and the infrastructure to [b]see and modify[/b] who's wearing what to which effect.
The few [b]story segments[/b] in ParAdise have also been completely restored.
[b]InvAsion is coming home![/b]
[b]0.1.2[/b] will put a heavy focus on polishing [b]dialogue interactions[/b] and creating a sustainable [b]tile-mapping infrastructure[/b].
InvAsion is thus the perfect poster child to not only [b]prototype[/b] and [b]polish[/b] these features, but also the perfect opportunity to integrate it into [b]ANARCHY proper[/b].
ANARCHY 0.1.1 is live
Boot ANARCHY and grab the [b]achievement[/b] for completing ExcommunicAtion, if you haven't already.

notes.title: Cheers! 🥂
notes.content:
[b]Hey handsomes! 😊[/b]

It's been ten days since [b]ANARCHY 0.1[/b] came out. So I think it's high time we sit down and have a cute little chat about a couple of things. [b]First and foremost[/b], though:

[h3]You guys are killing it! 🥳[/h3] 
In its first week, ANARCHY blasted through AUTONOMY's records – both in regards to [b]distribution[/b] and [b]player retention[/b]. Don't take my word for it, though! Have a little diagram, instead:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/2eb9b7b9f5b0d8f39f0f71d4b1e194acce1909c7.png[/img][h3]Upwards trajectory[/h3]
Be it the new engine, the combat system or any other additions ANARCHY brings to TRACHI – one thing is abundantly clear: [b]The results are all thanks to you! 🥰[/b]

So please give yourself a loving pat on the shoulder, whenever you can! In the meantime, I'll try to [b]keep my promise[/b] and give you as much insight into [b]development[/b] as I can. Speaking of: Let's take a little look at some of the things coming with [b]ANARCHY 0.1.1[/b]!

[previewyoutube=SWTrjUjmicg;full][/previewyoutube][h2]The future[/h2]
ANARCHY's [b]first patch[/b] will include a whole bunch of [b]fixes[/b] and [b]QoL elements[/b]. Most of these features were already implemented pre-release, but needed a bit more [b]testing[/b]. Now that we've got a bit of time on our hands before the next major release, I think it's the perfect chance to roll them out!

[h2]Status[/h2]
In 0.1, the [b]status screen[/b] is only available in field mode. Come 0.1.1, it'll also be accessible during encounters. Pressing the [b]info button[/b] will then either display the stats of the currently [b]active combatant[/b] or the [b]selected target[/b]. Most of these stats are currently nonfunctional for ExcommunicAtion, they will however play a big role in ParAdise and on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/0e6ef3ea7de0c946799ea7593193dd13cdb759ea.png[/img]
[h2]Glyphs[/h2]
All over the game, [b]button prompts[/b] will display a glyph of the corresponding [b]input[/b]. These dynamically adapt to the device your last input came from – i.e. [b]keyboard[/b] or [b]controller[/b]. Not only is this great for overall accessibility, but also opens the door to design a UI that utilizes a whole range of input keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/672c2954b2b2c4fd07f6a52f7e9633bb35e1d693.png[/img]
[h2]!Conversation[/h2]
A new option in the Main Menu can now set a global flag to [b]skip all conversations[/b]. If you're gunning to [b]replay ExcommunicAtion[/b] for the combat, this option's tailor-made for you. A button for in-conversation skipping is also planned, along with a couple of adjustments both to the message log and auto mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/94792bf196f209bd5b669a1d4c9a2cf57ad483a1.png[/img]
[h2]Threat[/h2]
At the moment, [b]AI[/b] combatants choose their targets based on [b]proximity[/b]. There is however already an implementation to override that. Going forward, I'd like to test these features to generate a more [b]dynamic aggro table[/b] and also give both the players and enemies [b]more tools[/b] to forcefully [b]redirect attention[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/65a72a024bc61ac16595fbb3da7e24f6f76aee0e.png[/img]
[h2]Un Deux Trois[/h2]
As a first step, Phase 3 of ExcommunicAtion will undergo a slight rework. [b]Ganymede[/b] will now always [b]prioritize Monoliths[/b] over the player. More than that, he'll also get a shiny new skill called "Un Deux Trois". This ability simultaneously hits all enemy monoliths and turns them to Ganymede's side.

To counteract this, the player also gets a new ability called "[b]Provoke"[/b]. This places a buff on its user, forcing all enemies in the vicinity to attack them for a specific duration (currently 4 Turns).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/c8ef6b17c791b66446c931db7bd2765693064777.png[/img]
[h2]ParAdise on Earth[/h2]
And of course, a couple of building blocks for [b]Lornz'[/b] big great adventure are included as well! Most of these concern [b]combat segments[/b] that precede ExcommunicAtion. Among the restored features are [b]AOE spells[/b] as well as proper [b]EXP & loot allocation[/b], along with several balance adjustments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/a82145a2270433b7a49ae986e9edd4a2dc66fb51.png[/img]
[h2]To conclude[/h2]
It's a big patch, considering it's versioned as a minor update. More than ever, I'd be super duper happy if you could take a gander once [b]0.1.1[/b] is released. As for the date itself, I'm aiming for September 21st. 

I'll post a proper announcement once we're there, so feel free to keep an eye on the game, if you can. 👀

Either way, it's been a real pleasure releasing this! Once again, [b]thank you tons for all the support[/b]! If there's anything you'd like to see realized within the game, please always feel free to get in touch with me.

Until then, big hugs from a friend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/dd22e8d10c2bbbed98d3ac884d106f80b8988f93.png[/img]

[b]much love[/b]
nory

notes.title: ANARCHY 0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hey friends![/h1]

[h3]ANARCHY's first public build has just been released! 🎉[/h3]
As an [b]early-access[/b] build, there's inevitably a couple of "ifs" and "buts" attached. And since I love nothing more than being on the same page as you, I wanted to accompany this release with a couple of clarifications regarding [b]scope and features[/b].

[h2]ExcommunicAtion[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/16547a47e2ce6f0caab75107b8d1e10793a566ab.png[/img]
This is [b]ANARCHY's introduction[/b] and should automatically launch once you hit "PLAY" for the first time. I won't spend too many words on it here, because I believe this one's mostly able to [b]speak for itself[/b]. There are, however, two or three things I'll mention in regards to core features down below.

[h2]ParAdise (Prototype)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/b429fff2a567fe30740c1b5d4cd0a00075019ac9.png[/img]
A very early version of [b]ANARCHY's prologue[/b] in its current state. Please see this mostly as a [b]technical showcase[/b], without any aspiration to resemble the final product. In fact, I've been struggling on whether to include this at all. However, I definitely wanted to show you [b]where the road is going[/b], and would be incredibly delighted if you could [b]weigh in with any thoughts and takes[/b] you might have.

[h2]Stats and stuff[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/bd27e3ae048f76971ca8702c1a8a64fb6905d79a.png[/img]
At the [b]end of ExcommunicAtion[/b], your progress will be recorded and synced via [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/achievements][b]Steam Stats[/b][/url]. This means that it's persistent [b]across all devices and versions[/b] as well. In other words: Unless something goes wrong, [b]you won't have to replay the intro[/b] again. Either way, please do get in touch with me if this particular piece of content remains inaccessible to you.

[h2]Dialogue[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/5ac9d55a4fd5fbdc3c67e9e6b5e9a17949df3d64.png[/img]
In some cases [b]dialogue bubbles[/b] place themselves on the [b]edge of the screen[/b]. If that should happen to you, please let me know. In case any meaningful bits of the dialogue get cut off, please use the [b]message log[/b] as a temporary workaround.

[h2]Input[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/7caf4a1a4e701f110643b7e5628dceef4359b727.png[/img]
ANARCHY 0.1 aims to offer [b]full mouse[/b], [b]keyboard[/b] and [b]controller support[/b]. Unfortunately, with the amount of devices out there, it's impossible to test every configuration. In other words: if you find yourself unable to complete an in-game action, please reach out to me.

[h2]Outlook[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/6ed7573b562a4ab28add74e0f54c036326c6c39e.png[/img]
During [b]September[/b], I'll try to focus on [b]bug-fixing[/b] et al. Come [b]October[/b], work on [b]ParAdise[/b] will commence. As you can imagine, I can't wait to get underway and [b]build a world together with you[/b]. But before we get there, please enjoy everything that's out right now to your hearts content! 😊

[h2]To Conclude[/h2]
0.1 is the product of hundreds of hours of work. Please understand that – at it's core – [b]TRACHI[/b] is a [b]one man project[/b]. As a result, I both need and appreciate [b]every bit of help[/b] I can get. If you'd like to get involved, please do [b]shoot me a message[/b] either via Steam or Discord anytime.

One way or another, I remain [b]your most fervent admirer[/b].
And – from the bottom of my heart – wish you the very best! 🤗

[b]much love[/b]
nory

notes.title: TRACHI
notes.content:
[h1]Hey friends![/h1]

[b]Jolly good greetings, and a big warm welcome to you! [/b]😊
Wherever you come from, and whatever you want to be – both of us know life isn't easy.

So let's kick back for a minute and imagine a place! 👀

[h1]TRACHI[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/d2e73ec02a2c715a171cace5a954c6b2522d9f52.png[/img]
Very much the same as ours. Joy and misery, and so on. Characters – [b]people[/b], trying to survive. In a world with [b]finite resources[/b] and [b]infinite dreams[/b], not everyone's a winner. Someone has to get the short end of the stick. Sometimes, [b]someone has to die[/b].

[h1]Fictional History[/h1]
TRACHI – AUTONOMY illustrated this never-ending struggle through the events of [b]3 1/2 days[/b] in and around a city called [b]Trachi[/b]. Following the tracks of [b]three spies[/b] from another country, ten years of history converged on a single moment. One moment, and a choice.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811440/TRACHI__AUTONOMY/

[h1]Cause and effect[/h1]
Where there's a choice, there's consequences. For the people involved, and for others too. Regardless, we have to live with it. Everyone who's lost someone can undoubtedly confirm that this sometimes is a terribly painful process.

[h1]Accountability[/h1]
It's no wonder we strive to find an explanation. Where there's suffering, there has be a reason, or at least a cause. Someone – or something – has to be responsible. And if something doesn't present itself, we'll make it up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/5effac79e10c877ade8f4a15bebcf86abce559b0.png[/img][h1]alleluia[/h1]
Within the world of TRACHI, there's a nation called [b]IONIA[/b]. Born from a bloody revolution, the country has embraced a fanatical belief in purity. In the eyes of its most ardent believers, the entire cosmos is engulfed by a fire that burns everything in its wake.

[h1]T-Day[/h1]
It's a cute little story, if it weren't for all the violence it justified. To make matters even worse: it's not THAT far from the truth. Following its release in [b]2019[/b], [b]AUTONOMY[/b] received a countless number of [b]updates[/b]. Piece by piece, its impurities were burned away, leading to the present state of things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/c80cfaa01d8e3edb3b39c93cf7e716c890bece26.png[/img]
[h1]METAMORPHOSIS[/h1]
To be honest, it never was easy on me. I love both the characters and the world as if they were family. But the truth of the matter is: They weren't good enough. I always believed TRACHI is a story worthy to be heard. But for that, the characters – [b]the people[/b] – had to be better.

[h1]A promise[/h1]
If there really was no other way. If they really were to be erased over and over again, the least I could do is to let them in on it. To grant them knowledge of what they are, the world they live in – and most importantly: the reason why these things are done to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/4a119f411b28c7b71d4cec0d3c3995f8bb1d6c2a.png[/img]
[h1]Prometheus[/h1]
You probably guessed from the name of the games, so let me confirm your suspicions: TRACHI is a story about emancipation. Both AUTONOMY and ANARCHY are two steps on a stairway to heaven. Or in our own words: Reality.

[h1]ICU2[/h1]
Between our world and theirs, there's something like a backroom. A frameless void with nothing in it but the things that come and go. Last year, two people came to this place. One of them stayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/24731ecef011702676d4c7d1fa56fc86aaf7a709.png[/img]
[h1]ECSTASY[/h1]
Said person witnessed a new version of himself. And was – like everything else – consigned to the dustbin of TRACHIAN history. Neither dead nor alive, an entire world is waiting to wake up again.

[h1]ANARCHY[/h1]
As for when that's going to happen: Piece by piece, over the course of the next three years. Most of the core features are already implemented, including primary combat, RPG and dialogue systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061845/41a056838a27a68efa8c5256f328256aa77a7ab7.png[/img]
[h1]Burden of proof[/h1]
But don't take my word for it! There's already more than six hours of [b]devlogs[/b] presenting the current state of things. If you'd like to have a look, you can find them on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@trachi/streams]TRACHI's Youtube channel[/url].

[h1]People[/h1]
Tomorrow, for example, we'll even do a double whammy! Kicking things off at [b]2PM CEST[/b] we'll continue our series of character examinations. This time around, we'll take an in-depth look at none other than the [b]white witch of Hermingrad[/b] – also known as Daphne.
[previewyoutube=e-8B-3-QTcU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Devlog 06[/h1]
Afterwards, we'll do our weekly examination of where we're at in terms of development. This time around, there'll be a focus on [b]UI[/b] and [b]combat balance[/b], concluded with a very first peek at ANARCHY's [b]act structure[/b] and [b]protagonists[/b].
[previewyoutube=wobc4plbguw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
At any rate, I hope that this little overview gave you a rough idea what TRACHI is about. I'll be back sometime around [b]late July / early August[/b] with an introduction of what's coming your way very (!) soon. The [b]28th August[/b] is TRACHI's birthday, after all. 😏

Until then and beyond, I'm more than eager than eager to hear your thoughts either here, via [url=https://www.youtube.com/@trachi]YouTube[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/SvaYDEUasg]Discord[/url]. 

Either way, I hope you have a great and comfy couple of weeks. 🌴

[b]Much love[/b]
nory
